tasks.title: Audit implementation against the canon and all 12 pillars
tasks.acceptance_criteria: The audit report records the dirty-worktree scope and committed baseline `40c04f172ff91d8002c8d51c4922c8abc6b59a37`. All 1,891 catalog rows now have an explicit status and review basis: 369 `GAP`, 267 `PARTIAL`, 1,255 `UNKNOWN`, zero `UNVERIFIED`; TODO links are retained and gates validate the inventory. Current lint/typecheck/test/build and traceability checks pass. This closes audit triage only—not implementation, owner ratification, production certification, or release approval.

tasks.title: Reconcile product identity references to the official canon
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Audit references to A-L-L-A-H.COM and MoonWitness; canonical wording links to `docs/vision/ALLAH_COM_OFFICIAL_CANON.md`; no companion document redefines identity or confers religious authority.

tasks.title: Complete repository and GitHub permission inventory
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Record account, organization, repository, team, role, and inaccessible/unknown scopes with evidence and exact observation time; distinguish verified access from unavailable data.

tasks.title: Specify search and indexing boundaries
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Define `ql_search` inputs, source-of-truth boundary, indexing/update/delete lifecycle, rights/private-field exclusions, query API, ownership, failure behavior, and tests; no canonical content is owned by indexes.

tasks.title: Decide storage scope and write its security contract
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Decide whether external/object storage is in the approved scope; if yes, specify ownership, access, encryption, rights, retention/deletion, limits, threat model, and verification; if no, record the deferral and trigger.

tasks.title: Complete the visual brand specification under the official identity
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Define approved wordmark/identity usage, voice, palette ownership, and tenant-brand boundary in the canonical design document; preserve the official canon and label concept art as illustrative until approved.

tasks.title: Inventory and name design tokens
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Publish semantic token names and values for light/dark themes, typography, spacing, elevation, borders/radii, focus, and status; verify every token has one canonical owner in `@moonwitness/ui`.

tasks.title: Decide and specify the tenant and workspace model
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Record whether and how tenants exist, membership/ownership rules, isolation and sharing boundaries, identity/ACL effects, and migration implications; add cross-tenant negative tests to the acceptance plan.

tasks.title: Set measurable performance and reliability targets
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Owner-approved targets cover latency, throughput, corpus/search scale, availability, and recovery where applicable; each target names measurement method, environment, and release gate.

tasks.title: Specify per-domain contracts and events/notifications
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Select a single contract-depth policy; define the previously missing events/notifications contract, then map every required §4.4 attribute to its canonical owner and a test/evidence source.

tasks.title: Resolve domains without estate-source material
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Owner disposition exists for `ql_creative`, `ql_journey`, `ql_org`, `ql_person`, and `ql_search`; in-scope domains have first-principles scope, entities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria rather than invented source data.

tasks.title: Define task dependency and domain DoD rules
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every proposed task has explicit prerequisite task IDs or `—`; every approved domain has a bounded DoD covering manifest, models/views, ACL, contract, and tests; the task graph is acyclic.

tasks.title: Define the GitHub label taxonomy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Document a small label set for task ID, domain, type, priority, and status with definitions and usage rules; no label is created until owner approval.

tasks.title: Map GitHub Issues, Projects, and Milestones to TODO goals
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Define one-to-one issue/task linking, required issue fields, project fields, and milestone mapping; prepare the mapping without creating platform objects.

tasks.title: Reconcile TODO phase numbering with the legacy phase catalog
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Owner-approved mapping uses the D30 catalog's phase IDs; Cloudflare MW-0500 workstream is explicitly cross-referenced without mislabeling it as catalog PHASE 12.

tasks.title: Ratify a stable planning baseline and disposition prior work
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Owner records accept/amend decisions against an exact commit SHA, including already-landed work and its evidence; the release/implementation gate is explicit and reproducible.

tasks.title: Create approved GitHub governance records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only after owner approval, create agreed labels, task-linked Issues, Project fields, and milestone records; verify each external record maps to exactly one TODO task and no duplicate scope exists.

tasks.title: Retire the legacy master prompt after requirement migration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 1,891 source statements are preserved in D30 with one canonical document and task link; implementation status is triaged separately (369 GAP, 267 PARTIAL, 1,255 UNKNOWN; none UNVERIFIED), not certified; both catalog-backed gates and their prompt-free regression tests pass; no live authority or tooling reads the retired file.

tasks.title: Repository foundation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved repository structure, scripts, and ownership rules are documented and verified by clean install and baseline checks.

tasks.title: Unified Web/API bootstrap
tasks.acceptance_criteria: One web and one API bootstrap start successfully; no duplicate application or identity authority is introduced.

tasks.title: Routing
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved routes resolve in the unified app, with role gates and localized route behavior tested.

tasks.title: Application shell
tasks.acceptance_criteria: One accessible shell supports required navigation, profile/context controls, and truthful loading/error/empty states.

tasks.title: Design system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: `@moonwitness/ui` owns reusable components and semantic tokens; required control states and theme variants pass component tests.

tasks.title: I18N
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Indonesian and English catalogs have type-safe keys, parity tests, route persistence, and locale-aware formatting.

tasks.title: Database
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Addon models synchronize through QlOrm; no Drizzle schema or migration files; integrity and ownership tests pass.

tasks.title: Authentication
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved identity/session flow works end-to-end; session lifecycle and negative authentication tests pass.

tasks.title: Authorization
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Deny-by-default route/model ACL and owner/tenant isolation pass cross-owner and cross-tenant negative tests.

tasks.title: Logging and error handling
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Structured errors/logs are actionable, correlation-aware, and contain no secrets or private payloads in tests.

tasks.title: API contracts
tasks.acceptance_criteria: DTOs, paths, and SDK calls have one owner in `@moonwitness/moonclient`; contract tests cover success and invalid input.

tasks.title: Tests
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Relevant unit, addon, API, UI, accessibility, and negative security tests pass on a clean run.

tasks.title: Docker
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Clean build and container startup succeed from the documented compose/deployment path without undeclared local state.

tasks.title: Health checks
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Readiness/liveness behavior is documented and verified for healthy, starting, and unavailable dependencies.

tasks.title: Source-to-publication lifecycle: select and identify an approved source/edition

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Selected source and edition have recorded owner, rights basis, version, provenance, and stable identifiers.

tasks.title: Source-to-publication lifecycle: validate rights and stage content
tasks.section: PHASE 9–10 — First Vertical Slice and Domain Expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Import rejects or quarantines records without required rights/provenance; repeat import is idempotent and reports rejected rows.

tasks.title: Source-to-publication lifecycle: create sourced claim and attach evidence
tasks.section: PHASE 9–10 — First Vertical Slice and Domain Expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Claim, evidence, interpretation, and exact source text remain distinct and traceable; cross-owner/private-field tests pass.

tasks.title: Source-to-publication lifecycle: human review and publication decision
tasks.section: PHASE 9–10 — First Vertical Slice and Domain Expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer decisions capture actor, timestamp, reason, and state; unapproved or rights-incompatible records are not public.

tasks.title: Source-to-publication lifecycle: end-to-end acceptance
tasks.section: PHASE 9–10 — First Vertical Slice and Domain Expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: The complete approved Horizon 1 journey passes in `id` and `en`, keyboard-accessibly, with auditable provenance and honest failure states.

tasks.title: Expand only approved domains in dependency order
tasks.section: PHASE 9–10 — First Vertical Slice and Domain Expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each approved domain has its own TODO task and DoD; dependencies follow the ratified domain graph; each addon passes manifest/model/ACL/view/contract tests before integration.

tasks.title: Verify domain boundaries
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ownership, dependency, and prohibited-write tests pass; no duplicate canonical owner or forbidden dependency remains.

tasks.title: Verify API consistency
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All routes and DTOs match shared moonclient contracts; contract tests pass for each shipped route.

tasks.title: Verify database integrity
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Constraints, QlOrm sync, referential integrity, isolation, and rollback tests pass on a clean database.

tasks.title: Verify rights
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every displayed, indexed, exported, or published source has current rights and attribution evidence; denied rights fail closed.

tasks.title: Verify security
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Auth, ACL, ownership, private fields, secrets, input limits, and abuse cases pass documented negative tests.

tasks.title: Verify UX
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Primary journeys and all functional controls are verified at supported viewport sizes; no dead controls or misleading states.

tasks.title: Verify I18N
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Translation parity, long-string layout, date/number formatting, locale switching, and fallback tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify accessibility
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Keyboard, focus, labels, contrast, screen-reader semantics, and reduced-motion checks pass against the agreed standard.

tasks.title: Verify performance
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Benchmarks meet owner-approved targets and include reproducible environment, workload, and measured results.

tasks.title: Verify backup
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Backup completes for approved persistent data; integrity and retention evidence are recorded without exposing secrets.

tasks.title: Verify restore
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Restore is executed in an isolated environment and meets approved recovery-point/time targets with evidence.

tasks.title: Verify Docker deployment
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Clean deployment, health checks, configuration validation, and rollback are exercised using the documented container path.

tasks.title: Verify failure recovery
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Injected dependency and process failures recover or fail closed as specified; data integrity and user-visible errors are verified.

tasks.title: Merge to `dev`
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approved PR targets `dev`; required review and checks pass on the exact merge SHA.

tasks.title: Verify integration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Integration suite, build, and acceptance evidence pass on the exact `dev` SHA.

tasks.title: Promote to `main`
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only verified `dev` is promoted through the approved protected-branch process; resulting SHA is recorded.

tasks.title: Generate version
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Version follows the approved release policy and uniquely identifies the promoted source SHA.

tasks.title: Update changelog
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Changelog matches included work and links each shipped task/decision to evidence.

tasks.title: Publish release
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Release artifact/tag is published from the verified SHA and passes post-publish checks.

tasks.title: Update documentation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: User, API, architecture, and operations docs match the released behavior; no proposal is described as shipped.

tasks.title: Begin the next approved milestone
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Next milestone is owner-approved, has unique TODO task IDs, dependencies, acceptance evidence, and no duplicate GitHub issues.

tasks.title: Add mandatory task-tracker workflow and a local status editor
tasks.section: Developer tooling — canonical project task tracker
tasks.status_label: Implemented; focused tests and browser verification pass
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A mandatory repository skill maps every coding task to the canonical register; a Python stdlib localhost-only UI safely edits task state, preserves custom status labels, records known completion times, and regenerates TODO.md; focused tests and tracker gates pass.
